verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents its own overlay-network feature for multi-node training with torch/NCCL, which gives instances on different machines a private virtual LAN. Self-serve signup with credit-card top-up means no sales cycle is needed. However, the overlay only works across machines on the same physical LAN, and nothing documents a high-speed interconnect such as InfiniBand or RDMA, or a one-step cluster provisioning flow. missing for 10: documented fast interconnect (InfiniBand/RoCE/NVLink across nodes) for multi-node, a first-class cluster provisioning workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-node training performance.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle

citations.quote: Vast now supports creating *overlay* networks for instances, allowing client instances on different machines on the same physical LAN to share a private, virtual LAN
Create an account on vast.ai. Verify your email address. ... Go to Billing → Add Credit and top up
